title: A letter to a neighborhood journal
passage:
To: Mina Ortiz
Subject: Your letter about the street piano

Dear Mina,

Thank you for writing about the street piano in our January issue. Our replies column normally features [131] ____ to articles from a single issue. I would like to include yours in March.

Several readers have asked whether the dates appearing in reader letters are publication dates or the dates of the events described. They do not show when the issue came out. The dates in our print column mark when the letters [132] ____; each letter’s text gives the event date separately.

You asked us not to print your surname. We can use your first name and the initial you suggested. [133] ____ That way, you can check the name line before it goes to print.

I’ve kept your description of the piano as it is. I removed the detailed directions to your apartment, [134] ____ your letter can still describe where the sound carries without identifying your home.

Lena, Replies Editor
passageZh:
收件人：Mina Ortiz
主旨：你談街頭鋼琴的來信

Mina 你好：

謝謝你來信談到我們一月號介紹的街頭鋼琴。來函回覆專欄通常會刊登針對同一期刊物文章的[131] ____。我想在三月號刊登你的來信。

有幾位讀者詢問，讀者來信旁的日期究竟是刊出日期，還是信中提到的事件日期。這些日期不是該期刊物的出刊日。紙本專欄上的日期標示各封信[132] ____的時間；事件日期則另寫在各封信的正文中。

你希望我們不要刊登你的姓氏。我們可以使用你的名字，並加上你建議的姓氏首字母。[133] ____這樣你就能在付印前確認署名。

你對鋼琴的描述我原樣保留。我刪除了前往你住處的詳細路線，[134] ____你的來信仍能說明琴聲傳到哪裡，又不會暴露你的住處。

來函回覆編輯 Lena

To: Mina Ortiz
Subject: Your letter about the street piano

Dear Mina,

Thank you for writing about the street piano in our January issue. Our replies column normally features reader responses to articles from a single issue. I would like to include yours in March.

Several readers have asked whether the dates appearing in reader letters are publication dates or the dates of the events described. They do not show when the issue came out. The dates in our print column mark when the letters were sent; each letter’s text gives the event date separately.

You asked us not to print your surname. We can use your first name and the initial you suggested. I’ll send you a preview of the heading and name line. That way, you can check the name line before it goes to print.

I’ve kept your description of the piano as it is. I removed the detailed directions to your apartment, so that your letter can still describe where the sound carries without identifying your home.

Lena, Replies Editor
